content.text:
No blockers found in the monthly conversion.

UTC bucketing resets dates to the first day before month iteration, so January 31 and leap February cannot skip months. Exact decimal sums, gaps, negatives, missing amounts, currency handling, and undated exclusions remain intact. MP earnings retain their category filter; funder timelines include all categories. Both callers and chart copy consistently use months. Signed bar geometry and pie, tooltip, and history behavior are unchanged.

The new tests cover both routes, same-month merging, February gaps, negative bars, timezone boundaries, and leap-year iteration. I reviewed source only, without running suites.

Comment review across all seven changed files: zero deletion recommendations, zero `MUST KILL` flags, no comments requiring exceptions.
